chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Said from Hammad from Rib'i from Sama'ah, and Al-Hasan from Zur'ah from Sama'ah, said:
The time for the Dhuhr prayer on Friday is when the sun begins to decline.

key_terms.تَزُولُ: Declines (referring to the sun's movement from its zenith)

ai.seo_question: When does the time for Friday Dhuhr prayer begin according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Transmitted through the chain of Sama'ah, a prominent companion of Imam al-Sadiq, this hadith anchors the Friday Dhuhr prayer to the exact moment of solar zenith (zawal), distinguishing it from the general noon prayer. This precise timing is crucial in Shia jurisprudence for ensuring the congregational aspect of the Friday prayer coincides with the optimal time for the Dhuhr prayer, thereby merging the individual obligation with the communal duty.
